exist only finitely many triples of coprime integers (a, b, c) such thata+b=c

example, Fermat’s Last Theorem (FLT) for exponentn≥6 is a direct corollary

[3] for a detailed survey). Also, Roth’s theorem [17] and Faltings’ theorem [8]
both follow from the ABC conjecture [23]; note that the proof of each theorem
earned its corresponding author a Fields medal.
